data.name: PREHISTORIA
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Prehistoria, a cutting edge simulation of the prehistoric world. Born into a harsh tropical island teeming with life, you'll need to scavenge, survive, and grow to become part of the living ecosystem. Explore the world and learn the secrets to survival through experience.

DO MORE THAN JUST SURVIVE

Giant dinosaur fights are awesome, and you'll experience plenty of during your life. But the prehistoric world was vast and varied, living in this ecosystem will require understanding not just it's dinosaurs but its insects, plants, and diseases as well.

MASSIVE SELECTION OF SPECIES

Stomp, swim, jump and fly with a huge selection of playable Dinosaurs. From Pterosaurs to Therapods, you're experience in Prehistoria will not only be on land but flying high in the clouds and lurking in the murky shallows of the island. Each species uses it's own physical strengths in specialized ways so every life is unique.

FORM PACKS AND RAISE BABIES

Grow into a full adult and you'll be able to forge relationships with compatible dinosaurs. Travel and hunt together and even breed babies that will inherit your features. Bring them food and raise them to become their own dinosaur capable of survival.

DEEP CUSTOMIZATIONS AND PROGRESSION

Introducing a DNA based customization system that allows you to create near infinite variations of dinosaurs. Pass your DNA down to your offspring with unique modifications.

A WORLD OF DISCOVERY

Discovery is a key part of Prehistory. Everything in the world will require inspecting and interacting to understand how it fits into your life. Expect to make mistakes. Expect to learn from them. Life is learning after all...

LIMB BASED DAMAGE AND PHYSICS BASED COMBAT

Building on the combat system from King of Bones, Prehistoria has a skill based tactile combat system that honors the true physicality of ancient giants. Opting for a more realistic and approach this time, the combat is even more varied and dynamic, do no expect to beat an adult T. Rex as a young triceratops. Weigh the decision of engaging in fights with larger opponents carefully, each battle could be your last.

PERMADEATH WITH A TWIST

Losing your life will cost you everything, and age comes for all living things. But pass on your DNA to your baby and start life again by becoming your offspring and surviving as the next generation. How long can your lineage survive?

EXPLORE A VAST PREHISTORIC OPEN WORLD

This is our largest world BY FAR. Highly detailed with distinct sub-biomes and regions that change the look and feel of the world. Traverse the massive chain of tropical islands to discover unique and rare dinosaur species and subspecies.

DYNAMIC TIME, SEASONS, AND WEATHER

The prehistoric world is dangerous but beautiful. Full day and night cycles, seasons, and years pass by as you live from generation to generation. Witness breathtaking sunsets on the sandy shores of the Emerald Isles and take shelter from torrential downfalls deep within the heart of the jungle.

AN OBSESSION WITH DETAIL

Prehistoria pushes the absolute limit of visual and audio fidelity. Everything in the world responds to your movements and vocalizations. Deep audio detailing make every experience true to life and truly immerses you in the prehistoric reality around you.

Prehistoria is a simulation-survival experience like no other, raising the bar for immersive gameplay, unique mechanics, and detailed world building.

data.short_description: Survival is only the beginning... Welcome to Prehistoria, an immersive simulation of prehistoric life. Create your dinosaur, explore an ancient island lost in time, grow strong and form packs, and raise your babies to carry on your lineage in a never ending circle of life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2070 or equivalent with 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3070 or equivalent with 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
